    z_FAA_task_B     = z_DyadMean_Problem_FAA - mean(z_DyadMean_Problem_FAA, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_lg2CogEmp_B  = z_lg2DyadMean_CogEmp - mean(z_lg2DyadMean_CogEmp, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_lg2AffEmp_B  = z_lg2DyadMean_AffEmp - mean(z_lg2DyadMean_AffEmp, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_lg2PD_B       = z_lg2DyadMean_PD - mean(z_lg2DyadMean_PD, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


#Path A Models (Predicting Mediators from Predictors)  
# Path a1: Cognitive Empathy
m_cog_HR <- lmer(z_lg2CogEmp_PC ~ z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + z_Problem_FAA_PC + (1 | DyadID), data = All_data_centered) #later add neutral baseline FAA as covariate
summary(m_cog_HR)

# Path a2: Affective Empathy
m_aff_HR <- lmer(z_lg2AffEmp_PC ~ z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + z_Problem_FAA_PC + (1 | DyadID), data = All_data_centered)
summary(m_aff_HR)

# Path a3: Personal Distress
m_PD_HR <- lmer(z_lg2PD_PC ~ z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + z_Problem_FAA_PC + (1 | DyadID), data = All_data_centered)
summary(m_PD_HR)

#Paths B & C' Model (Predicting Outcome from Mediators + Predictors)
# Paths b1-b3 (from mediators to outcome) and c'1-c'2 (direct effects of predictors to outcome)
m_out_HR <- lmer(z_HR ~ 
                   z_lg2CogEmp_PC + z_lg2AffEmp_PC + z_lg2PD_PC + #mediators (b paths)
                  z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + z_Problem_FAA_PC + #predictors (c' paths)
                  (1 | DyadID), data = All_data_centered)

summary(m_out_HR)


#Testing the Indirect Effects (a x b)

# Define mediation paths syntax
med_model_HR <- '
  # Path A equations
  z_lg2CogEmp_PC   ~ a11*z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + a12*z_Problem_FAA_PC      #first digit is mediator number; second digit is predictor number (predictors: baseline FAA is (j = 1); task FAA is (j = 2). mediators: cognitive empathy is (i = 1); affective empathy is (i = 2); personal distress is (i = 3))
  
  z_lg2AffEmp_PC   ~ a21*z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + a22*z_Problem_FAA_PC 
  
  z_lg2PD_PC ~ a31*z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + a32*z_Problem_FAA_PC 

  # Paths B & C-prime equations
  z_HR ~ b1*z_lg2CogEmp_PC + b2*z_lg2AffEmp_PC + b3*z_lg2PD_PC + 
           cp1*z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + cp2*z_Problem_FAA_PC 

  # Indirect Effects for Baseline FAA -> HR
  ind_base_cog_HR := a11 * b1
  ind_base_aff_HR := a21 * b2
  ind_base_PD_HR := a31 * b3
  total_ind_base_HR := ind_base_cog_HR + ind_base_aff_HR + ind_base_PD_HR

  # Indirect Effects for Task FAA -> HR
  ind_task_cog_HR := a12 * b1
  ind_task_aff_HR := a22 * b2
  ind_task_PD_HR := a32 * b3
  total_ind_task_HR := ind_task_cog_HR + ind_task_aff_HR + ind_task_PD_HR
'


#Fit with cluster-robust standard errors for DyadID
fit_HR <- sem(
  med_model_HR, 
  data = All_data_centered, 
  cluster = "DyadID", 
  missing = "fiml",  #Keeps partial cases using all available model data
  se = "bootstrap",
  bootstrap = 1000,
  iseed = 42
)

summary(fit_HR, standardized = TRUE, ci = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE) #in output, pay attention to a, b and c paths in parentheses


#export to table
HR_med_results <- parameterEstimates(
  fit_HR,
  standardized = TRUE,
  ci = TRUE,
  boot.ci.type = "perc"
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(op %in% c("~", ":=")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Add significance stars matching sjPlot style
    Stars = case_when(
      pvalue < .001 ~ "***",
      pvalue < .01  ~ "**",
      pvalue < .05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ ""
    ),
    Estimate = sprintf("%.3f%s", est, Stars),
    SE = sprintf("%.3f", se),
    `95% Boot CI` = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", ci.lower, ci.upper),
    z = sprintf("%.2f", z),
    Beta = sprintf("%.3f", std.all)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Label = label,
    Outcome = lhs,
    Predictor = rhs,
    B = Estimate,
    SE,
    `95% Boot CI`,
    z,
    Beta
  )

# Page 1: First 4 columns (Label, Outcome, Predictor, B)
ft_page1 <- HR_med_results %>%
  dplyr::select(1:4) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  theme_booktabs()

# Page 2: Remaining columns
# Tip: Include an identifier column (e.g., Label or Predictor) so readers know which row is which,
# or use dplyr::select(5:8) if you strictly want 4 columns with no repeated labels.
ft_page2 <- HR_med_results %>%
  dplyr::select(Predictor, 5:8) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  add_footer_lines("* p < .05, ** p < .01, *** p < .001 (1,000 bootstrap draws).")

# Combine into one Word document with a page break between tables
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_page1) %>%
  body_add_break() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_page2)

print(doc, target = "Full_Mediation_Results_HR.docx")

#create path diagram to visualize results (adjust any desired formatting in powerpoint as code not cooperative)

# 1. Extract the semPlot model object
sem_obj_HR <- semPlotModel(fit_HR)

# 2. Extract p-values and match keys safely
pe_HR <- parameterEstimates(fit_HR)
pe_HR$key <- paste(pe_HR$lhs, pe_HR$op, pe_HR$rhs)
sem_obj_HR@Pars$key <- paste(sem_obj_HR@Pars$lhs, sem_obj_HR@Pars$op, sem_obj_HR@Pars$rhs)
sem_obj_HR@Pars$pvalue <- pe_HR$pvalue[match(sem_obj_HR@Pars$key, pe_HR$key)]

# 3. Set line type safely (1 = Solid for p < .05, 2 = Dashed for p >= .05)
sem_obj_HR@Pars$lty <- ifelse(
  !is.na(sem_obj_HR@Pars$pvalue) & sem_obj_HR@Pars$pvalue < 0.05,
  1, # Solid line
  2  # Dashed line
)

# 4. Get exact variable names in model order
vars_in_model_HR <- sem_obj_HR@Vars$name

# 5. Define node labels (FIXED: mapped to label_map_HR)
label_map_HR <- c(
  "z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC" = "Resting\nFAA",
  "z_Problem_FAA_PC"          = "Task\nFAA",
  "z_lg2CogEmp_PC"            = "Cognitive\nEmpathy",
  "z_lg2AffEmp_PC"            = "Affective\nEmpathy",
  "z_lg2PD_PC"                = "Personal\nDistress",
  "z_HR"                      = "HR"
)

custom_labels_HR <- label_map_HR[vars_in_model_HR]

# 6. Define 2D Layout Matrix coordinates (X, Y)
pos_map_HR <- list(
  "z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC" = c(1.0, 5.5),
  "z_Problem_FAA_PC"          = c(1.0, 4.0),
  "z_lg2CogEmp_PC"            = c(3.5, 4.75),
  "z_lg2AffEmp_PC"            = c(3.5, 3.25),
  "z_lg2PD_PC"                = c(3.5, 1.75),
  "z_HR"                      = c(6.0, 3.25)
) 

# Safe layout construction (prevents dropping NULLs and size mismatches)
lay_HR <- do.call(rbind, lapply(vars_in_model_HR, function(v) {
  if (!is.null(pos_map_HR[[v]])) {
    return(pos_map_HR[[v]])
  } else {
    return(c(1, 1)) # Fallback coordinate for unmapped latent/residual terms
  }
}))

# 7. Export High-Resolution PNG Diagram
png("EmpMed_Path_Diagram_HR.png", width = 14, height = 9, units = "in", res = 300)

semPaths(
  sem_obj_HR,
  what = "std",
  layout = lay_HR,
  intercepts = FALSE,
  residuals = FALSE,
  fade = FALSE,
  nodeLabels = custom_labels_HR,
  edge.label.cex = 0.65,
  sizeMan = 7,
  node.width = 1.6,
  node.height = 0.9,
  asize = 1.8,
  mar = c(3, 4, 3, 4),
  color = list(lat = "white", man = "aliceblue")
)

dev.off()



#testing between-Dyad mediation (how one dyad differs relative to another)

# Collapse individual-level data into 1 row per DyadID
dyad_level_data_HR <- All_data %>%
  group_by(DyadID) %>%
  summarise(
    # 1. Dyad-Mean Predictors (Baseline & Task FAA)
    z_FAA_baseline_B = mean(z_RestingBaseline_FAA, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_FAA_task_B     = mean(z_Problem_FAA, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 3. Dyad-Mean Mediators (Dyad Empathy & Distress Climate)
    z_CogEmp_B       = mean(z_lg2CognitiveEmpathyFrequency, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_AffEmp_B       = mean(z_lg2AffectiveEmpathyFrequency, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_PD_B           = mean(z_lg2NesfPersonalDistressFrequency, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 4. Dyad-Mean Outcome (HR)
    z_HR_B       = mean(z_HR, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Check that the new data frame has exactly 30 rows (1 per dyad)
nrow(dyad_level_data_HR)

#Define the Between-Dyad Model Syntax
med_model_between_HR <- '
  # --- Path A: Predictors & Covariates -> Dyad-Level Mediators ---
  z_CogEmp_B ~ a11_b*z_FAA_baseline_B + a12_b*z_FAA_task_B  
  z_AffEmp_B ~ a21_b*z_FAA_baseline_B + a22_b*z_FAA_task_B  
  z_PD_B     ~ a31_b*z_FAA_baseline_B + a32_b*z_FAA_task_B  

  # --- Path B & C\': Mediators & Predictors -> Dyad-Level HR ---
  z_HR_B ~ b1_b*z_CogEmp_B + b2_b*z_AffEmp_B + b3_b*z_PD_B + 
               cp1_b*z_FAA_baseline_B + cp2_b*z_FAA_task_B 

  # --- Indirect Effects (Between-Dyad / Climate Mediation) ---
  ind_base_cog_b := a11_b * b1_b
  ind_base_aff_b := a21_b * b2_b
  ind_base_pd_b  := a31_b * b3_b
  
  ind_task_cog_b := a12_b * b1_b
  ind_task_aff_b := a22_b * b2_b
  ind_task_pd_b  := a32_b * b3_b
'

#Fit the Between-Dyad Model
fit_between_HR <- sem(
  med_model_between_HR,
  data = dyad_level_data_HR,
  se = "bootstrap",
  bootstrap = 1000,
  missing = "FIML"
)

# View results with standardized parameters
summary(fit_between_HR, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)

#bootstrap CIs

# 1. Set seed so your bootstrapped CIs are 100% reproducible every time you run it
set.seed(42)

# 2. Fit the between-dyad model with bootstrapping

  data = dyad_level_data_HR,
  se = "bootstrap",
  bootstrap = 1000,
  missing = "FIML"
)

# 3. View results with 95% Bootstrapped Confidence Intervals
summary(
  fit_between_HR, 
  fit.measures = TRUE, 
  standardized = TRUE, 
  rsquare = TRUE, 
  ci = TRUE # Displays bootstrapped CIs
)



#Whether autonomic measures will mediate the relationship between trait and task-based motivational state and cognitive empathy 

#participant(dyad)-centering: How much higher or lower an individual scores compared to their own partner / dyad average
#between-dyad-centering: How much higher or lower a dyad's overall average is compared to the entire sample's average
#testing Within-Dyad mediation (how an individual differs relative to their partner)

All_data_centered <- All_data %>%

  # --- STEP 1: Calculate Dyad-Level Means ---
  group_by(DyadID) %>%
  mutate(
    # Compute the average score for each dyad for predictors and mediators
    z_DyadMean_RestingBaseline_FAA = mean(z_RestingBaseline_FAA, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_DyadMean_Problem_FAA    = mean(z_Problem_FAA, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_lg2DyadMean_RMSSD       = mean(z_lg2RMSSD_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_DyadMean_HR      = mean(z_HR, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  # --- STEP 2: Compute Person-Centered & Between-Dyad Variables ---
  mutate(
    # A. WITHIN-DYAD (Person-Centered): Individual Score - Dyad Mean
    z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC = z_RestingBaseline_FAA - z_DyadMean_RestingBaseline_FAA,
    z_Problem_FAA_PC     = z_Problem_FAA - z_DyadMean_Problem_FAA,
    z_lg2RMSSD_ms_PC  = z_lg2RMSSD_ms - z_lg2DyadMean_RMSSD,
    z_HR_PC  = z_HR - z_DyadMean_HR,

    # B. BETWEEN-DYAD (Grand-Mean Centered Dyad Mean): Dyad Mean - Grand Mean
    z_FAA_baseline_B = z_DyadMean_RestingBaseline_FAA - mean(z_DyadMean_RestingBaseline_FAA, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_FAA_task_B     = z_DyadMean_Problem_FAA - mean(z_DyadMean_Problem_FAA, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_lg2RMSSD_ms_B  = z_lg2DyadMean_RMSSD - mean(z_lg2DyadMean_RMSSD, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_HR_B  = z_DyadMean_HR - mean(z_DyadMean_HR, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


#Path A Models (Predicting Mediators from Predictors)  
# Path a1: RMSSD
m_RMSSD_CE <- lmer(z_lg2RMSSD_ms_PC ~ z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + z_Problem_FAA_PC + (1 | DyadID), data = All_data_centered)  
summary(m_RMSSD_CE)

# Path a2: HR
m_HR_CE <- lmer(z_HR_PC ~ z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + z_Problem_FAA_PC + (1 | DyadID), data = All_data_centered)
summary(m_HR_CE)

#Paths B & C' Model (Predicting Outcome from Mediators + Predictors)
# Paths b1-b3 (from mediators to outcome) and c'1-c'2 (direct effects of predictors to outcome)
m_out_CE <- lmer(z_lg2CognitiveEmpathyFrequency ~ 
                   z_lg2RMSSD_ms_PC + z_HR_PC + #mediators (b paths)
                  z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + z_Problem_FAA_PC + #predictors (c' paths)
                  (1 | DyadID), data = All_data_centered)

summary(m_out_CE)


#Testing the Indirect Effects (a x b)

# Define mediation paths syntax
med_model_CE <- '
  # Path A equations
  z_lg2RMSSD_ms_PC   ~ a11*z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + a12*z_Problem_FAA_PC      #first digit is mediator number; second digit is predictor number (predictors: baseline FAA is (j = 1); task FAA is (j = 2). mediators: cognitive empathy is (i = 1); affective empathy is (i = 2); personal distress is (i = 3))
  
  z_HR_PC   ~ a21*z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + a22*z_Problem_FAA_PC 


  # Paths B & C-prime equations
  z_lg2CognitiveEmpathyFrequency ~ b1*z_lg2RMSSD_ms_PC + b2*z_HR_PC +  
           cp1*z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + cp2*z_Problem_FAA_PC 

  # Indirect Effects for Baseline FAA -> CE
  ind_base_RMSSD_CE := a11 * b1
  ind_base_HR_CE := a21 * b2
  total_ind_base_CE := ind_base_RMSSD_CE + ind_base_HR_CE

  # Indirect Effects for Task FAA -> CE
  ind_task_RMSSD_CE := a12 * b1
  ind_task_HR_CE := a22 * b2
  total_ind_task_CE := ind_task_RMSSD_CE + ind_task_HR_CE
'


#Fit with cluster-robust standard errors for DyadID
fit_RMSSD_HR_CE <- sem(
  med_model_CE, 
  data = All_data_centered, 
  cluster = "DyadID", 
  missing = "fiml",  #Keeps partial cases using all available model data
  se = "bootstrap",
  bootstrap = 1000,
  iseed = 42
)

summary(fit_CE, standardized = TRUE, ci = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE) #in output, pay attention to a, b and c paths in parentheses

#export to table
RMSSD_HR_CE_med_results <- parameterEstimates(

) %>%

    ),

  )

All_data_centered <- All_data %>%

  # --- STEP 1: Calculate Dyad-Level Means ---
  group_by(DyadID) %>%
  mutate(
    # Compute the average score for each dyad for predictors and mediators
    z_DyadMean_RestingBaseline_FAA = mean(z_RestingBaseline_FAA, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_DyadMean_Problem_FAA    = mean(z_Problem_FAA, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_lg2DyadMean_RMSSD       = mean(z_lg2RMSSD_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_DyadMean_HR      = mean(z_HR, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  # --- STEP 2: Compute Person-Centered & Between-Dyad Variables ---
  mutate(
    # A. WITHIN-DYAD (Person-Centered): Individual Score - Dyad Mean
    z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC = z_RestingBaseline_FAA - z_DyadMean_RestingBaseline_FAA,
    z_Problem_FAA_PC     = z_Problem_FAA - z_DyadMean_Problem_FAA,
    z_lg2RMSSD_ms_PC  = z_lg2RMSSD_ms - z_lg2DyadMean_RMSSD,
    z_HR_PC  = z_HR - z_DyadMean_HR,

    # B. BETWEEN-DYAD (Grand-Mean Centered Dyad Mean): Dyad Mean - Grand Mean
    z_FAA_baseline_B = z_DyadMean_RestingBaseline_FAA - mean(z_DyadMean_RestingBaseline_FAA, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_FAA_task_B     = z_DyadMean_Problem_FAA - mean(z_DyadMean_Problem_FAA, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_lg2RMSSD_ms_B  = z_lg2DyadMean_RMSSD - mean(z_lg2DyadMean_RMSSD, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_HR_B  = z_DyadMean_HR - mean(z_DyadMean_HR, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


#Path A Models (Predicting Mediators from Predictors)  
# Path a1: RMSSD
m_RMSSD_AE <- lmer(z_lg2RMSSD_ms_PC ~ z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + z_Problem_FAA_PC + (1 | DyadID), data = All_data_centered)  
summary(m_RMSSD_AE)

# Path a2: HR
m_HR_AE <- lmer(z_HR_PC ~ z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + z_Problem_FAA_PC + (1 | DyadID), data = All_data_centered)
summary(m_HR_AE)

#Paths B & C' Model (Predicting Outcome from Mediators + Predictors)
# Paths b1-b3 (from mediators to outcome) and c'1-c'2 (direct effects of predictors to outcome)
m_out_AE <- lmer(z_lg2AffectiveEmpathyFrequency ~ 
                   z_lg2RMSSD_ms_PC + z_HR_PC + #mediators (b paths)
                  z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + z_Problem_FAA_PC + #predictors (c' paths)
                  (1 | DyadID), data = All_data_centered)

summary(m_out_AE)


#Testing the Indirect Effects (a x b)

# Define mediation paths syntax
med_model_AE <- '
  # Path A equations
  z_lg2RMSSD_ms_PC   ~ a11*z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + a12*z_Problem_FAA_PC      #first digit is mediator number; second digit is predictor number (predictors: baseline FAA is (j = 1); task FAA is (j = 2). mediators: cognitive empathy is (i = 1); affective empathy is (i = 2); personal distress is (i = 3))
  
  z_HR_PC   ~ a21*z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + a22*z_Problem_FAA_PC 


  # Paths B & C-prime equations
  z_lg2AffectiveEmpathyFrequency ~ b1*z_lg2RMSSD_ms_PC + b2*z_HR_PC +  
           cp1*z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC + cp2*z_Problem_FAA_PC 

  # Indirect Effects for Baseline FAA -> AE
  ind_base_RMSSD_AE := a11 * b1
  ind_base_HR_AE := a21 * b2
  total_ind_base_AE := ind_base_RMSSD_AE + ind_base_HR_AE

  # Indirect Effects for Task FAA -> AE
  ind_task_RMSSD_AE := a12 * b1
  ind_task_HR_AE := a22 * b2
  total_ind_task_AE := ind_task_RMSSD_AE + ind_task_HR_AE
'


#Fit with cluster-robust standard errors for DyadID
fit_AE <- sem(
  med_model_AE, 
  data = All_data_centered, 
  cluster = "DyadID", 
  missing = "fiml",  #Keeps partial cases using all available model data
  se = "bootstrap",
  bootstrap = 1000,
  iseed = 42
)

summary(fit_AE, standardized = TRUE, ci = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE) #in output, pay attention to a, b and c paths in parentheses

#export to table
RMSSD_HR_AE_med_results <- parameterEstimates(
  fit_AE,
  standardized = TRUE,
  ci = TRUE,
  boot.ci.type = "perc"
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(op %in% c("~", ":=")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Add significance stars matching sjPlot style
    Stars = case_when(
      pvalue < .001 ~ "***",
      pvalue < .01  ~ "**",
      pvalue < .05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ ""
    ),
    Estimate = sprintf("%.3f%s", est, Stars),
    SE = sprintf("%.3f", se),
    `95% Boot CI` = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", ci.lower, ci.upper),
    z = sprintf("%.2f", z),
    Beta = sprintf("%.3f", std.all)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Label = label,
    Outcome = lhs,
    Predictor = rhs,
    B = Estimate,
    SE,
    `95% Boot CI`,
    z,
    Beta
  )

# Page 1: First 4 columns (Label, Outcome, Predictor, B)
ft_page1 <- RMSSD_HR_AE_med_results %>%
  dplyr::select(1:4) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  theme_booktabs()

# Page 2: Remaining columns
# Tip: Include an identifier column (e.g., Label or Predictor) so readers know which row is which,
# or use dplyr::select(5:8) if you strictly want 4 columns with no repeated labels.
ft_page2 <- RMSSD_HR_AE_med_results %>%
  dplyr::select(Predictor, 5:8) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  add_footer_lines("* p < .05, ** p < .01, *** p < .001 (1,000 bootstrap draws).")

# Combine into one Word document with a page break between tables
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_page1) %>%
  body_add_break() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_page2)

print(doc, target = "Full_Mediation_Results_RMSSD_HR_AE.docx")

#create path diagram to visualize results (adjust any desired formatting in powerpoint as code not cooperative)

# 1. Extract the semPlot model object
sem_obj_AE <- semPlotModel(fit_AE)

# 2. Extract p-values and match keys safely
pe_AE <- parameterEstimates(fit_AE)
pe_AE$key <- paste(pe_AE$lhs, pe_AE$op, pe_AE$rhs)
sem_obj_AE@Pars$key <- paste(sem_obj_AE@Pars$lhs, sem_obj_AE@Pars$op, sem_obj_AE@Pars$rhs)
sem_obj_AE@Pars$pvalue <- pe_AE$pvalue[match(sem_obj_AE@Pars$key, pe_AE$key)]

# 3. Set line type safely (1 = Solid for p < .05, 2 = Dashed for p >= .05)
sem_obj_AE@Pars$lty <- ifelse(
  !is.na(sem_obj_AE@Pars$pvalue) & sem_obj_AE@Pars$pvalue < 0.05,
  1, # Solid line
  2  # Dashed line
)

# 4. Get exact variable names in model order
vars_in_model_AE <- sem_obj_AE@Vars$name

# 5. Define node labels (FIXED: mapped to label_map_HR)
label_map_AE <- c(
  "z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC" = "Resting\nFAA",
  "z_Problem_FAA_PC"          = "Task\nFAA",
  "z_lg2RMSSD_ms_PC"            = "RMSSD",
  "z_HR_PC"            = "Heart Rate",
  "z_lg2AffectiveEmpathyFrequency"                      = "Affective\nEmpathy"
)

custom_labels_AE <- label_map_AE[vars_in_model_AE]

# 6. Define 2D Layout Matrix coordinates (X, Y)
pos_map_AE <- list(
  "z_RestingBaseline_FAA_PC" = c(1.0, 5.5),
  "z_Problem_FAA_PC"          = c(1.0, 4.0),
  "z_lg2RMSSD_ms_PC"            = c(3.5, 4.75),
  "z_HR_PC"            = c(3.5, 3.25),
  "z_lg2AffectiveEmpathyFrequency"   = c(6.0, 3.25)
) 

# Safe layout construction (prevents dropping NULLs and size mismatches)
lay_AE <- do.call(rbind, lapply(vars_in_model_AE, function(v) {
  if (!is.null(pos_map_AE[[v]])) {
    return(pos_map_AE[[v]])
  } else {
    return(c(1, 1)) # Fallback coordinate for unmapped latent/residual terms
  }
}))

# 7. Export High-Resolution PNG Diagram
png("AutonomMed_Path_Diagram_AE.png", width = 14, height = 9, units = "in", res = 300)

semPaths(
  sem_obj_AE,
  what = "std",
  layout = lay_AE,
  intercepts = FALSE,
  residuals = FALSE,
  fade = FALSE,
  nodeLabels = custom_labels_AE,
  edge.label.cex = 0.65,
  sizeMan = 7,
  node.width = 1.6,
  node.height = 0.9,
  asize = 1.8,
  mar = c(3, 4, 3, 4),
  color = list(lat = "white", man = "aliceblue")
)

dev.off()

# Collapse individual-level data into 1 row per DyadID

  group_by(DyadID) %>%
  summarise(
    # 1. Dyad-Mean Predictors (Baseline & Task FAA)
    z_FAA_baseline_B = mean(z_RestingBaseline_FAA, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_FAA_task_B     = mean(z_Problem_FAA, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 3. Dyad-Mean Mediators (Dyad Empathy & Distress Climate)
    z_lg2RMSSD_ms_B       = mean(z_lg2RMSSD_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_HR_B       = mean(z_HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 4. Dyad-Mean Outcome (HR)
    z_AE_B       = mean(z_lg2AffectiveEmpathyFrequency, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#Define the Between-Dyad Model Syntax
med_model_between_AE <- '
  # --- Path A: Predictors -> Dyad-Level Mediators ---
  z_lg2RMSSD_ms_B ~ a11_b*z_FAA_baseline_B + a12_b*z_FAA_task_B  
  z_HR_B ~ a21_b*z_FAA_baseline_B + a22_b*z_FAA_task_B  

  # --- Path B & C\': Mediators & Predictors -> Dyad-Level HR ---
  z_AE_B ~ b1_b*z_lg2RMSSD_ms_B + b2_b*z_HR_B + 
               cp1_b*z_FAA_baseline_B + cp2_b*z_FAA_task_B 

  # --- Indirect Effects (Between-Dyad / Climate Mediation) ---
  ind_base_RMSSD_b := a11_b * b1_b
  ind_base_HR_b := a21_b * b2_b
  
  ind_task_RMSSD_b := a12_b * b1_b
  ind_task_HR_b := a22_b * b2_b
'

#post hoc sensitivity analyses

#H1a
# 1. Define Bulletproof Power Evaluation Function
get_power_bulletproof <- function(target_beta, target_icc, fitted_model, predictor_name, nsim = 300) {
  
  clean_data <- model.frame(fitted_model)
  
  emp_tau2  <- as.numeric(VarCorr(fitted_model)[[1]])
  emp_sig2  <- sigma(fitted_model)^2
  total_var <- emp_tau2 + emp_sig2
  
  target_tau_sd   <- sqrt(target_icc * total_var)
  target_sigma_sd <- sqrt((1 - target_icc) * total_var)
  
  current_fixef <- fixef(fitted_model)
  current_fixef[predictor_name] <- target_beta
  
  mod_formula <- formula(fitted_model)
  
  sim_model <- makeLmer(
    formula = mod_formula,
    fixef   = current_fixef,
    VarCorr = target_tau_sd^2,
    sigma   = target_sigma_sd,
    data    = clean_data
  )
  
  ps <- powerSim(
    sim_model, 
    test = fixed(predictor_name, "chisq"), 
    nsim = nsim, 
    progress = FALSE
  )
  
  return(summary(ps)$mean)
}

# 2. Set Up Sensitivity Grid
pred_var       <- names(fixef(m1.H1a.clean))[2] #change value depending on which fixed effect of interest
candidate_iccs <- c(0.10, 0.30, 0.50)
beta_grid      <- seq(0.10, 0.60, by = 0.05)

fine_grid <- expand.grid(
  ICC   = candidate_iccs, 
  Beta  = beta_grid, 
  Power = NA
)

# 3. Execute Simulation Grid
set.seed(123)
cat("Running Monte Carlo sensitivity grid across ICCs and Betas...\n")

for (i in 1:nrow(fine_grid)) {
  fine_grid$Power[i] <- get_power_bulletproof(
    target_beta    = fine_grid$Beta[i],
    target_icc     = fine_grid$ICC[i],
    fitted_model   = m1.H1a.clean,
    predictor_name = pred_var,
    nsim           = 500
  )
}

# 4. Interpolate Exact Beta for 80% Power Threshold
get_exact_mdes_interpolated <- function(df_icc) {
  df_icc <- df_icc %>% arrange(Beta)
  
  idx_above <- which(df_icc$Power >= 0.80)[1]
  
  if (is.na(idx_above) || idx_above == 1) {
    return(NA) # Power did not cross 80% within tested grid
  }
  
  idx_below <- idx_above - 1
  
  b1 <- df_icc$Beta[idx_below]
  b2 <- df_icc$Beta[idx_above]
  p1 <- df_icc$Power[idx_below]
  p2 <- df_icc$Power[idx_above]
  
  # Linear interpolation formula
  exact_b <- b1 + (0.80 - p1) * (b2 - b1) / (p2 - p1)
  return(round(exact_b, 3))
}

# 5. Extract Final Results Table
mdes_results <- fine_grid %>%
  group_by(ICC) %>%
  group_modify(~ data.frame(MDES_80_Power = get_exact_mdes_interpolated(.x)))

cat("\n--- Sensitivity Analysis Results (Exact MDES at 80% Power) ---\n")
print(mdes_results)

#ICC, MDES at 80% power
#1   0.1         0.363
# 2   0.3         0.341
# 3   0.5         0.315
